Hi Lara — thanks for the questions. Quick summary below; I've attached our IR plan and a draft SIG response spreadsheet.

High level timelines (operational targets):
- Initial acknowledgement to affected partners: within 24 hours of incident classification.
- Preliminary incident summary (impact, scope, immediate mitigations): within 72 hours.
- Full incident report and remediation plan: generally within 30 days (may vary depending on complexity).

Regulatory notifications:
- For incidents involving personal data subject to GDPR we will notify the supervisory authority within 72 hours when required; customer notifications follow contractual requirements and severity assessments.

Contacts & escalation roles (we'll provide aliases in SIG spreadsheet):
- Incident Response Lead: ir-lead@redwood.com (on-call)
- Security Ops Pager: +1-555-0102 (operational)
- CISO (legal escalation): ciso@redwood.com
- Privacy Counsel: privacy@redwood.com

Artifacts we can provide (redacted as needed): timeline, timeline-of-actions, sanitized logs, scoped packet captures, and post-incident root cause analysis. We do not share raw PII in artifacts; all evidence is reviewed.

Joint notifications: we support coordinated notifications in many cases and will work with you to align messaging and timing.

See attached: redwood_ir_plan_v3.pdf and sig_responses_20260321.xlsx

Best,

Evelyn Hart
Head of Trust & Safety
Redwood Inference

Hi Lara — Marcus here, Security Ops. Adding detail per your questions.

- 24-hour acknowledgement: this is an operational target we currently meet for production-impacting incidents; it is not a signed SLA in standard T&Cs but we can discuss a contract addendum for enterprise contracts.

- EU regulator coordination: yes — for incidents involving EU personal data we will coordinate timing with the affected customer. We typically draft joint notification language and agree on timing unless legal/regulatory obligations require immediate filing by one party.

- Escalation roster (roles & aliases):
  • IR Lead (alias): ir-lead@redwood.com
  • On-call SRE/Security Ops (pager): +1-555-0102 (pager)
  • CISO / Executive Escalation: ciso@redwood.com
  • Legal / Privacy Counsel: privacy@redwood.com
  • Customer Success (engagement): cs-team@redwood.com

Artifacts and evidence: we can provide a scoped set of artifacts — redacted timelines, sanitized logs, diag exports. We do not provide full raw backups or unredacted PII. For forensic needs we will work with your designated investigator under an NDA if required.

SIG spreadsheet guidance: refer to tab 'IR' in the attached sig_responses_20260325.xlsx — I've populated role aliases and typical response windows. Please review row IDs 42–58, and flag any that require contract-level commitments.

Attaching: sig_responses_20260325.xlsx, redwood_ir_plan_v3.pdf

Thanks,
